turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
For in-stock items, please allow 1–3 business days for processing and shipping from our warehouse, followed by 1–5 business days for delivery within the US. Promotions and holidays may add 2–3 business days.

If an item has a longer processing time, its estimated ship date appears on the product page, in your cart, and in your order confirmation email.
